map.评估机器/人工收获的损失率，分析损失来源并提出优化建议: Assess machine/manual harvest loss rate, analyze sources, and suggest optimization
map.总损失 = 理论产量 − 实际收获量；损失率 = 总损失 ÷ 理论产量 × 10: Total loss = theoretical yield - actual harvest; loss rate = total loss / theoretical yield x 100%; each share = each loss / theoretical yield x 100%
map.总损失率由理论产量与实际收获量之差计算。另按割台/掉穗、脱粒/清选、夹带/抛撒、: Total loss rate is from theoretical minus actual yield. Separately sum four stages - header/grain drop, threshing/cleaning, conveying/scattering, transport/storage - into "itemized loss rates" for cross-check. Loss rate <=3% very low, <=5% normal, <=8% high, >8% severe; when a stage exceeds its threshold give matching tuning advice (header height, drum speed, cleaning airflow, etc.).
map.损失率 = 落粒+漏割+清选损失 / 实测可收总量 × 100%。: Loss rate = (shattered + missed-cut + cleaning loss) / measured harvestable total x 100%.
map.按国标方法多点取样。: Sample at multiple points per national standard.
map.用于机械调整与作业质量验收。: Used for machine adjustment and operation-quality acceptance.
map.样框内落粒+夹带 22 g，对应可收 700 g，样点损失 3.1%。全田 15: In a frame, shattered + conveyed 22 g vs 700 g harvestable, point loss 3.1%. Whole-field 15 points average 2.8%, better than the rice machine-harvest <=3.5% standard, but missed-cut segment is high, suggesting header divider correction.
map.总损失怎么拆？: How to break down total loss?
map.分落粒（脱不净/抛洒）、漏割（分禾器漏株）、夹带（清选吹出）、破碎。定位最大分项: Into shattering (incomplete / scattered), missed cut (divider misses), conveying (blown out at cleaning), and breakage. Locate the largest item to tune the machine.
map.为什么验收要多点？: Why sample at multiple points for acceptance?
map.地头转弯、倒伏区、正常区损失差异大。单点易误判，按标准布点取均值才代表整田作业质: Turn rows, lodged areas, and normal areas differ greatly. A single point misleads; standard grid points averaged represent whole-field quality.
